title: QuestMinigame.cs
summary: The small base class every Quest-driven minigame derives from, so a Quest can open and wait on the breathing exercise, the Worry Courtroom, or any new minigame the same way.

notes.text: Derive from this and the Quest's 'Required Minigames' list will accept your component in its Minigame slot.
True while the minigame is on screen. QuestHUDController uses it to close anything still open when an episode ends.
Called by the Quest when its trigger fires (on start, a timer, a stress level, or finishing a conversation). Keep the quest so you can report back.
Close the screen. If the player closed it before finishing, also call Quest.NotifyMinigameClosed(this) so the same trigger can open it again.
Optional label for the Quest Journal. Leave blank to use the GameObject's name.

notes.match: public virtual string QuestDisplayName => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(questDisplayName) ? name : questDisplayName;
notes.text: The Journal shows this next to DONE / PENDING. The built-in minigames override it with a fixed, friendly name.
